senses.gloss: कतक कतक, m. The nut plant, Strychnos potatorum, which clears water, Man. 6, 67.

कतम क + तम, superl. of किम्, pron. n. ˚मद्. Who, what, which of many, MBh. 1, 4312; of two, 13, 3044.
 --With न and अपि, Not the least, Bhāg. P. 7, 15, 59.

कतर क + तर, compar. of किम्, pron. n. ˚रद्, Who, what, which of two, MBh. 1, 3645; of many, Vikr. 5, 14.
 --Cf. Lat. uter for cuter (ubi: alicubi), utrum; κότερον, ὁ-πότερος; Goth. hvathar; A.S. hvädher.

कातर कातर, i. e. कतर + अ (properly, irresolute), adj., f. रा, Timid, Rām. 4, 9, 103; disheartened, Śāk. 56, 13.
 --Comp.

कति कति, i. e. क, base of किम् + ति, pron.
 1. How many, Rām. 5, 73, 2.
 2. Some, Pañc. 171, 2; usually with following चिद्, Pañc. 87, 22; with अपि, Amar. 25.
 3. A proper name, Hariv. 1461.
 --Cf. Lat. quot.
कतिधा कति + धा, adv. In how many ways, Bhāg. P. 3, 6, 11.
कतिपय कतिपय (from कति), adj., f. या and यी, Some, Pañc. 9, 6.

कत्थ् कत्थ्, i. 1, Ātm.
 1. To boast, Chr. 24, 39.
 2. To praise, Rām. 3, 55, 8.
 3. To blame, Bhāg. P. 8, 7, 33. []
 --With the prep. वि वि,
 1. To boast, Rām. 6, 36, 42.
 2. To disparage, MBh. 4, 1299.
 --Caus. To humble, Draup. 9, 10.

कत्थन कत्थ् + अन,
 I. adj. Boasting, a boaster, Rām. 1, 6, 10.
 II. n. Boasting, Rām. 3, 35, 23.
कातरता कातर + ता, f., and कातरत्व कातर + त्व, n. Fear, Śāk. d. 59; Pañc. 216, 11.
कातर्य कातर्य, i. e. कातर + य, n. Fear, Rām. 4, 9, 100; apprehension (care), Ragh. 17, 47.

कात्यायन कात्यायन, i. e. कति, or कात्य + आयन,
 I. patron., f. नी, A descendant of कति or कात्य, used as proper name, Rām. 2, 67, 2.
 II. f. नी, A name of Durgā, Dev. 8, 28.
कति- + विध कति- + विध, adj. how manifold, MBh. 13, 6278.
